turns.replyText:
Hi Nora, I’m Nova AI, Fashion Nova’s AI customer care assistant. I’m not a human.

If you just placed an order and it hasn’t shipped yet, there’s sometimes a short window where the address may still be able to be updated.

What’s the order number (or the 9-character confirmation code from the checkout page)?

turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyText:
Yes, sometimes, but only in a short window right after you place it while the order is still on hold.

After that window, if it hasn’t shipped yet, we can ask the care team to try to cancel it before it’s fulfilled, but it isn’t guaranteed. Once an order has shipped or been delivered, it can’t be canceled.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyText:
No, items (and sizes, colors, quantities, shipping method, payment method, and discount codes) can’t be changed or added after checkout.

If you want the extra item, the fastest option is to place a new order for it. If needed, you can return the original order after delivery if it’s eligible.

turns.replyText:
You can update most account details and saved addresses from your account:

- Edit profile info and saved addresses: [My Info](https://www.fashionnova.com/account/addresses)

If you mean your login email, you can update it here (you’ll need access to both the old and new inboxes to verify): [Fashion Nova account profile](https://account.fashionnova.com/profile)

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyText: If the cancellation goes through, the refund is issued back to your original payment method, and it typically posts within **7–10 business days** (timing depends on your bank).
